Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed the WebSurfer to the IMDb locations page for title ID tt0462590 (the 2007 feature film) instead of the 1985 PBS telefilm (tt0088853), conflating two different adaptations. This led to pulling New Zealand filming information for the wrong production and created the subsequent discrepancy.
